scope: Four integrity finding families: off-window, scratch query, staging copy/publication, index rollback. Probe success confirms defects, not product certification. Candidate fixes remain pending.

findings.candidateFix: Capture physical images before the clean proof, revalidate the entire plan before first removal, retain per-removal expected fingerprints
findings.rootCause: The physical removal image was captured after the clean-worktree query
findings.impact: Later C is removed without discard and retained only in a technical backup of a completed transaction

findings.candidateFix: Use and verify a conservative scratch timestamp; retain official diff and source validation
findings.rootCause: Index bytes were copied but the native index timestamp boundary was not conserved
findings.impact: A newer scratch index mtime can make native diff miss racy worktree C

selectedAdd.selection: ONLY frontier selected-add from first receipt

findings.rootCause: Both source-to-scratch and generated-index-to-lock copies lost the native index temporal boundary
findings.impact: A selected C can remain unstaged as B after copying the native index; publishing a fresh copy can hide unstaged C from native diff
findings.candidateFix: Shared FD-based timestamp helper at both boundaries; preserve hashes locks publication tokens and staging durability barriers

publication.selection: ONLY publication-between-add-and-lock from equivalent same-scratch follow-up

findings.failureType: Controlled existing failpoint exception, not process termination power loss or physical IO error
findings.rootCause: Legacy backup image has bytes and mode but no proven original index mtime
findings.impact: Restoring exact B raw bytes with a newer index mtime makes native diff conceal C; C bytes remain on disk
findings.candidateFix: Conservative epoch-plus-one-second timestamp on validated MAIN/private restoration temporary only, synchronized via proven FD; all plan backup hash V05 and revocation guards remain required

limits: Windows/NTFS observations do not certify other platforms or filesystems.
Probe exit zero means the defect oracle completed, not that the product passed.
Off-window began while the candidate suite was active; the suite was coordinated to stop after racy confirmation. Experiment times are not product benchmarks.
The racy fixture controls workfile metadata; it does not estimate occurrence frequency in ordinary use.
The original index mtime was never modified by the racy probe.
Timestamp-preserving and epoch1 copies are prototypes, not certification of the later fix.
No live repository, project remote or global Git configuration was used as a fixture.
Raw external evidence remains retained; public projection omits personal paths and process identifiers.
